physical_normalization: Full I including Gamma/Euler/cosh; W and Lambda are bare source quantities.
relation_scope: Exact finite coefficient reconstruction in registered rational Hlog/formal-period coordinates; not a whole all-epsilon reduction to BJ.

definitions.crossing: A plus/minus suffix denotes (f(z)+/-f(1/z))/2; bare M parity is (-1)^(j+1).
definitions.M: M_kj=int_0^1 W(x)^k L(x)^j/(x-z/(1+z)) dx; W=log(x(1-x)), L=log(z)+log((1-x)/x), j>=1, removable inner zero.
definitions.F3: F3_abcde=[p^a q^b r^c s^d t^e] 3F2(p,q,r;1+s,1+t;-z); raw Taylor coefficient, no derivative factorials.
definitions.BJ: BJ_stu_ijk=[a^i b^j c^k] int_0^1 (1-X_s*x)^a J_b(X_t*x)J_c(X_u*x) dx/x; X0=1,X1=-z; raw Taylor coefficient.
definitions.J: J_b(x)=int_0^x((1-t)^b-1) dt/t; the explicit GPL rule and single-series recurrences are given in the linked derivation.
